scenes.anchor_text: “Above silence, the illuminating storms—dying storms— illuminate the silence above.”
scenes.scene_description: A vast landscape is illuminated by fading storms, revealing a silent, desolate world both above and below the storm clouds. The composition focuses on the sky and the interaction between the light of the storms and the pervasive silence.
